entities.summary: Bulgarian Empire, a political institution in Kosovo during Medieval Kosovo and the Serbian Kingdom (500–1170). Grew from Roman Dardania Province. Led to the emergence of Slavic Settlement and Byzantine Era and Nemanjić Serbian Empire.
